problem: Host process execution could occur before a durable effect receipt existed, and causal re-entry was recorded later. A crash or generation/lease change could therefore leave an untracked or falsely-current external outcome.
implemented_contract: persist effect intent as PENDING before host execution
retain current-main explicit argv validation, shell denial and shell=false process boundary
recheck session generation and optional resource lease after host execution
record post-execution fence failure as STALE_OUTCOME with zero causal credit
commit effect outcome and causal re-entry atomically
recover restart-surviving PENDING effects as UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART with zero causal credit
engine reuses the causal record created by effect completion rather than duplicating it
